title: Shopify products
description: One item per product, with price, discount, variant-level stock and the change since the previous run.

store.description: Store domain as requested, e.g. allbirds.com

shopifyShop.description: The underlying myshopify.com shop hostname that served the catalog

productId.description: Shopify product id (numeric part of the gid)

url.description: Product page URL on the store domain

priceMin.description: Lowest variant price in major units (e.g. 110.0 for $110.00)

priceMax.description: Highest variant price in major units

compareAtPrice.description: Strike-through 'was' price; null when the product is not discounted

discountPct.description: Effective discount percentage derived from compareAtPrice

currency.description: ISO currency code from the store's default market

available.description: True when at least one variant is in stock

variants.description: Per-variant detail: SKU, title, price and availability

productType.description: First collection title, or the taxonomy category when no collection exists

sitemapUpdatedAt.description: Last modification date from the product sitemap. Changes on any edit, so it means 'recently modified', not 'newly published'.

changeType.description: What changed since the previous run of this actor for this store. null means unchanged (or change detection was off).

previousPrice.description: Price seen in the previous run, for price_drop / price_rise

changePct.description: Signed percentage change of priceMin, for price_drop / price_rise

firstSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the first run that saw this product

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the run that produced this item

baselineAvailable.description: True when a previous snapshot existed, i.e. changeType is meaningful

overview.title: Products
overview.description: Full catalog with prices and stock

changes.title: Changes only
changes.description: Filter to rows where changeType is set
